# Contracts

<!-- generated by .kb/generate.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

**Layer:** package  
**Status:** shipped

## Purpose

Zod schemas shared by API and web. The request/response shape is written once and both sides import it.

## Features

- Validation and inferred TypeScript types from the same declaration
- Grouped by domain: common, auth, tenancy, marketing

## Known limitations

- No runtime response validation on the web side — contracts type the response but nothing parses it
- Chosen over tRPC/ts-rest deliberately; revisit if a mobile client appears
